name: cosmograph

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.release:check: pnpm --filter @workspace/release-flags exec tsx --test src/index.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx src/check-release-version.ts
scripts.deploy:build: pnpm --filter @workspace/cosmograph run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:convex && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.gate: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:convex && pnpm run test:server && pnpm run test:deploy && pnpm run release:check

description: **A scientist's life's work, rendered as a galaxy you can fly through.**
